_doc: STANDARD tier — a reasonable safe build: high-signal warnings, cheap hardening, -O2, -g, linker hardening. A subset of the maximal flag-selection.json, authored directly. Rendered by the dependency-free C bootstrap helper, probed into .flags-standard/<cc>/, and selected by update.sh --standard. No sanitizers (a safe BUILD, not a test run) and none of the analyzer/exhaustive machinery. Every flag is probed per compiler, so unsupported ones (e.g. -Wl,-z,* on macOS ld64, -fstack-clash-protection on unsupported targets) are dropped automatically.

header: Standard warnings: the widely-agreed baseline plus the few extras that catch real bugs at low noise. Portable across gcc and clang.

entries.comment: C hygiene (C only; probe drops it for C++)

header: Standard build is optimized: -O2 powers uninitialized/stringop warnings that -O0 cannot, and is what a reasonable safe build ships.
Cheap runtime hardening that does not change program semantics.

entries.comment: probe drops it where unsupported (e.g. some clang targets)

header: Linker hardening. ELF only (Linux/FreeBSD); macOS ld64 rejects the -z family and the probe drops them there.
